What is the name of your father?
1. Write the words correctly. thermo therfa stersi 2. Who heads a family? 3. Mention four people found at school, home. 4. Name these family members.
A family is a group of people related by blood, marriage or adoption.
A nuclear family is a family having father, mother and children.
Extended family - An extended family is a family having father, mother, relatives in a family.
Aunt, uncle, grandfather, grandmother, niece, nephew, etc.
Father and mother are my parents.
Father of my parents is my grandfather.
Mother of my parents in my grandmother.
Sister of my parents is my aunt.
Brother of my parents is my uncle.
